text: The Patriots head to Buffalo facing a pair of significant defensive absences, as cornerback Christian Gonzalez and defensive tackle Christian Barmore are both ruled out with shoulder injuries, forcing Mike Reiss to analyze how New England will replace them against Josh Allen and the Bills. On the offensive side, the quarterback infrastructure continues to deteriorate with offensive lineman Greg Van Roten placed on injured reserve due to a thigh injury, though Drake Maye said Wednesday his right shoulder is fine and emphasized that better decision-making rather than physical limitations will be key to reversing the team's 1-2 start. The week does offer some positive news: wide receiver Mack Hollins was named the Week 4 NFLPA Community MVP after hosting a Special Olympics Family Field Day for over 100 athletes and their families, and offensive lineman Matt Pryor is joining the Patriots offense. Expert predictions are in on the matchup, and Josh Allen will look to put recent sloppy play behind him as Buffalo hosts the turnover-prone Maye and the Patriots.
